description:
From where the bullies get bullied – Zach Randolph and Tony Allen, two NBA legends and former teammates, are known for their toughness. Dubbed “The Grindfather” and “First Team”, the pair defined the “Grit and Grind” era of the Memphis Grizzlies. In Out The Mud, the duo shares the stories that formed their unique tenacity on their journeys through sport, entertainment, and music. Plugged into the culture unlike any other, Zach and Tony take on a star-studded lineup of guests, from the biggest artists in the rap game to the realest NBA players you’ve never heard of.

A Tidal League Original.
